title: HideHeldItemName
description: Completely disables the vanilla held item name tooltip shown above the hotbar when switching items.
body:
# Hide Held Item Tooltip

Tired of the item name popping up every time you switch items?

**Hide Held Item Tooltip** completely disables the vanilla held item name tooltip shown above the hotbar, giving you a cleaner and less distracting HUD.

Perfect for players who prefer a minimalist interface, create videos or screenshots, speedrun, or simply don't need the constant item name reminder.

### Features

* Removes the vanilla held item name popup.
* Keeps the rest of the HUD unchanged.
* Lightweight with no unnecessary features.
* Improves screen cleanliness and immersion.
* Works seamlessly during normal gameplay.

This mod only hides the held item name tooltip. It does **not** change item functionality, the hotbar, inventory, or any other game mechanics.
